steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: We're just... going to watch?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: We're just going to watch. But I have no idea what's happening.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: At least they're not hurting any civilians?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: And there's so much good food going to waste...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I hate to see it too. But I guess a street fight is just part of the party.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: It was planned?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Doesn't look like it. Oh, someone's coming.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Agh...! I think... I hit the wrong person...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Isn't it kind of unsafe to stay here?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I could go back to the office, but what would I even do there?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Don't you have a test tomorrow? In the afternoon?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Those two seem as if they are uninvolved in this event.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: We should ask them to leave. We would not want them to get hurt.
...Hold on, isn't that man up there with his belly cut open the Emperor of Penguin Logistics?
He's dead. And you seem not at all bothered?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Bothered? Why?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Mr. Emperor gets himself into such trouble several times a month. We have grown accustomed to this behavior.
His death?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Correct.
...Sounds like Mostima really shouldn't be getting close to you people.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: You worry about her?
I'm just here to make sure she doesn't do anything out of line.
But, hm, it's a really clumsy act. Since she looks so relaxed over there, I guess there isn't anything worth worrying about.
I'm going for a walk. Don't tell her I came. I'll go see her myself when things quiet down.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: ...There she goes.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: She shows up, asks her questions, and leaves just as suddenly as she appears.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Is this the way they do things in Laterano now?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Heh. I suddenly find myself envious of you young people.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You always choose your own paths, thinking only of yourselves. You don't consider your places in the grand scheme of things.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I also work hard.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But no one has ever been able to get to the bottom of you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If you ever really did, that would be the most frustrating of all.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Indeed. There are some things that should not be so thoroughly investigated. Especially those things that have to do with Mostima the Messenger.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What is this? Occupational discrimination?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I'm only speaking from experience.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Let's take a break for a moment now.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: My Arts are suppressed...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So you were the one holding back your strength all this time?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: As were you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But you have wasted enough time.

steps.name: Seemingly Ordinary Resident
steps.text: This little punk, how can he keep fighting...? Grr...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *Pant pant* I can... keep going... all night...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yep. You're doing great.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Good thing you were able to deal with so many bad guys so quickly.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey. We won't let you disappear on your own this time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So this guy's the evil mastermind pulling the strings here? I definitely owe him a personal beating!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We got ourselves one helluva workout today. And the bill's gettin' mighty long too.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Texas, I'm thinkin' there's a lot we ain't gonna get to expense here tonight...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Don't ask me. That's a question for the boss.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But the boss is dead...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Then it'll have to wait.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Speaking of, did anybody go deal with the boss's corpse? Leaving him up there to get trampled feels kind of...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: There we are. The players are assembled.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Young people always make their own choices.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Even if it means walking through a Catastrophe, leaving your bodies splattered and broken, you still proceed with such determination.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What is he talking about?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just a grandpa's muttering. Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Right then. Are you enjoying your Sauin?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: S'all right. Kinda like a hangover. No way I can think about what I gotta do tomorrow.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So... nobody's going to take care of the boss?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Penguin Logistics, you truly are unfathomable.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I think we don't need to worry about that, considering.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's Penguin Logistics. The whole reason for this war was someone questioning the boss's tastes.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm sorry, what?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: He gave his life to preserve his style. That's our Emperor.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But I must say, not one of you ever surprised me in the slightest.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mmmff! What's this sand?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: He still has the strength?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes... everybody focus. This fight is going to be different.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you let your guard down for even a split second,

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You'll die.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Sauin must be a lively event!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Let me see with my own eyes the freaks that Emperor raised.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: My blade broke the moment it touched the sand... that's a problem.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Mmm. In all my years, those bold enough to approach me with blade or bullet were few and far between.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll give him one of these!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oof, no good! Croissant, you're up!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: My hammer's already stuck in the quicksand! I can't move!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hopeless. Is this all you have, Penguin Logistics?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's not all.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: His sand shield is broken. Now, Exusiai!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's barrage time!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: How many guns do you have? Troublesome angel.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh? I've been blocked?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Thanks, Bison!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm up! Sorry fer the elder abuse!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Aagh! Couldn't get him! Texas, yer up!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Wishful thinking.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I got this, Texas!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hmm, a voice-based Originium Art. What an interesting little girl.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: How's your spatial awareness?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He even dodged from that angle...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: At least you made him move. When he takes us on just standing in one place, I feel like he's looking down on us.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Oh, Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That coat was a gift from my daughter.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: In all these years, you are the first to even touch it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: How many young people like you are in Lungmen? What are you capable of, actually?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's enough to just be yourself, isn't it? Or are you upset?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No, I just find myself with some... complex feelings...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But it's getting terribly late now, so it's time I——

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Mmng?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: He- he's been shot?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's that sniper from before. He's still here.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: ...Target down. Moving to confirm.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What have you done?!

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master, he was a threat.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: You should never have gone so close to him. He has an affinity for Originium Arts. I could not guarantee your safety.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: You must understand, the Young Master's safety is my number one priority.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...What you're saying is... I was bait?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: My father knew this would happen, so he sent you to...

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master, some things are not as they seem. You will come to understand in time. And I promise, the Master of the House had no intention of exploiting you at any time.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: And I believe Penguin Logistics will also be expecting an explanation. I must secure the Rat King's remains and confirm that he is deceased.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's fine. The boss is gone. There's no one to hear you explain.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Thank you for your understanding. Now, Young Master, do take care.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Bison, now is not the time to dwell on this.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The Rat King promised us a 'gift', don't forget.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It might be a bomb. That Siracusan guy really liked bombs.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That wouldn't be very clever.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: And there are still some enemies to worry about. It looks like they're waiting for us?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: The Rat King is gone, and they don't seem to be reacting at all?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Right, no reaction whatsoever. Hm... I think I know what's happening...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let's split up. Sora, Croissant, Exusiai, we'll take care of the remaining enemies.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Bison and Mostima, you deal with the 'gift.'

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's almost sunrise. We're running out of time.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Damn, where could it be...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're all flustered. Try not to be so emotional.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I did just find out that I was being kept in the dark about my whole purpose here.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Mostima, did we actually, maybe meet the Rat King before?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We did.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So you had it all figured out from the beginning?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ahahaha...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Don't try to wriggle out of this one!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm. I couldn't have guessed what he was really up to.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But we really don't have much time. The LGD aren't going to sit on their hands.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: As crazy as things have gotten around here, with them jumping in, there's no way we'd work it out.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Victorian gumdrops, the candy box, maybe that was a clue.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But it's just common sense that using the same kind of trap over again would be really dumb.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah, but, why?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: If the Rat King really had everything planned out, then us running into him before couldn't be a coincidence.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: He was communicating with us from the start.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's his trap. Why would he want to give us clues? That doesn't make any sense.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I don't know either, maybe we've been too quick to consider him an enemy...? I just have a feeling.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's not just a feeling. After we met the Rat King, he kept trying to hint at something... or something.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Mmm... Well, it's better than nothing.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: This is it..?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Looks like it's about 80cm by 40cm, but in an iron box... Yep, this definitely seems like a big gift box to me?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Could- could you explain?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Nope. I don't get it at all.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Then we better call up Texas, maybe she and the girls can——

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There's not enough time. This looks like it's got a timer on it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So it's a bomb?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So it's a bomb. Pretty cliche. Both in shape and execution.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Right... Mostima, you get out of here.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And what are you going to do?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Take a chance.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: This is a custom shield, and my body is pretty tough too. If I play this wrong, I might still survive.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you serious?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Then I want to see how this plays out. And don't worry, I might be able to mitigate the damage from the explosion.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's my job, after all.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I know. *Inhale*

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *Exhale* Here I go!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You decided? That wire's the same color as my hair.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Erm! M- Mostima! Don't joke with me please! I'm almost——

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It hit zero! Get behind me!!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Okay, okay.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Nnnngg...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Why isn't it hot?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Wait, this is... candy?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Pay attention to how you land. You don't want to break anything.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Not sure, but... Woweee! There's people fallin' from the sky?!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Ow ow ow, why is this happening again... Agh! S- sorry!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: S'all right. What're you two doin' up there? Playin' trapeze artist?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yowch! Somethin' just hit me?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...Candy?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It's raining... candy?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Ugh, it's that sickly sweet smell in the air again.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I think it's about time we wrapped this up.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hm? Um? Texas, do you know something we don't know?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No. But I have a pretty solid idea.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey!! If you had a lead, you should've told us!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sauin. It's long over.

steps.name: Rat King's Henchman
steps.text: ...Wanna get dim sum?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: So early? Let's go to the roof and watch the sunrise.

steps.name: Rat King's Henchman
steps.text: You mafia types are funny. Always with the sunrise on the roof...

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Gah. This candy's smashed into my head so much I think I got brain damage. It's the signal to stop, and I stopped.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: But boy, it's more like we just got beaten on. My whole body's so tender...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: They... they all stopped. What's going on? This doesn't feel right.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We're all done, just like that? These fellers love candy so much?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: The candy rain stopped.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yes, so fleeting. If only it would truly rain candy someday.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So there was the candy...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But wait, what about the bomb?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You mean this?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh? You took the whole thing apart?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just a minute.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Whoops, lost control there for a second. Hope you didn't get burned.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: This looks like an ordinary metal box?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...And there's one piece of candy inside. Ew, it melted. It's all sticky...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: And this note? Is it from the Rat King...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What does it say?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: 'Happy Sauin'...
